dedupe_keys.name: africa data centres association data centre operator members and countries of operation

description: This page lists the data centre operator members of the Africa Data Centres Association with the countries where each is active. Contents: Africa Data Centres (South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Zimbabwe, Rwanda), TelOne (Zimbabwe), Rack Centre (Nigeria), ONIX (Ghana, Senegal), DATACONNECT (Côte d'Ivoire, Benin), Open Access Data Centres (Nigeria, DR Congo, South Africa), iXAfrica (Kenya), GPX (Egypt), Wingu Africa (Djibouti, Somaliland, Ethiopia, Tanzania), Raxio (Angola, Mozambique, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Uganda), Equinix (Nigeria, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, South Africa), STELLARIX (Madagascar, Senegal, Tanzania), Sonatel (Senegal, Mali, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Sierra Leone) and a Togo operator, with links to their websites. The page also mentions supplier and independent consultant members and national associations. Producer: ADCA, the industry body for African data centre operators. Coverage: operators in more than 20 African countries, as listed. Access: a public page with operator links and no download. Licence and cost: free; no licence stated. Caveats: it lists operators and countries, not sites, capacities or tiers, and covers members only. Simulation uses: a starting point to identify data centre operators and their national footprints for capacity and resilience studies of African digital infrastructure. Related records: the African IXP Association directory (data-african-ixp-association-directory) and the Cloudscene directory (data-cloudscene-data-centre-directory).
